decision_authority: Evidence adjudication within the active Phase 2 survey; not owner release sign-off.
accepted_scope: Literal TRYJUMP reaches a found callee; the callee entry and selected argument/helper/order state are observed before a runtime fault, which is not converted to missing-target fallback. Existing selected missing/hit and missing-target argument-fault cases remain linked.

accepted_requirements.basis: Pinned v24 FunctionIdentifier.cs line 326 registers FunctionCode.TRYJUMP with CALL_Instruction(false,true,true,false); the executed fixture line is a literal TRYJUMP.
Native repeats and public pyz record callee entry, ARG=41, COUNT=1, ORDER=1, then divide-by-zero at ZZ285.ERB:18.

limitations: Only the finite found-callee error obligation and named paths are accepted; this is not exhaustive TRYJUMP grammar or arity/type coverage.
Native includes the caller frame in its fatal stack; public PyEmuera shows only the callee frame. This scoped diagnostic difference is retained.
Native natural exit and postfatal state are unobserved; no postfatal continuation is credited.
Only the literal target and selected helper argument are covered; other argument forms and control-flow contexts remain outside scope.
